name: Harrier
short_role: Use ranged pressure to isolate the defender closest to exhausting its ammunition.
question: Can the keep protect or replace the specialist whose reserve is nearly spent?
telegraph: A split-arrow marker points toward the eligible specialist with the lowest ammunition ratio.
failure_mode: A depleted specialist is disabled before recovery can reload the firing line.
report_phrase: Harrying Fire found the most depleted eligible specialist.
